description: We are a team of enthusiastic college students interested in space exploration, science, technology and innovation. We are excited to learn, collaborate and develop creative solutions using NASA's open data. We welcome members with skills in coding, research, design, electronics and problem-solving. Let's work together and create something innovative!
summary:
Lunar Legacy is an interactive web-based space heritage archive developed to address the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten." Our project highlights eight historical artefacts from NASA's Moon and Mars missions, helping people discover the technology, equipment, and stories behind past space exploration.

The website allows users to explore artefacts by planet, search for equipment and missions, and learn about the history and significance of space technology. Through an accessible and engaging digital experience, we aim to preserve the legacy of important space missions and make their contributions easier for everyone to discover.

This project matters because space exploration is not only about future discoveries; it is also about remembering the innovations, achievements, and stories that made today's exploration possible.
details:
LUNAR LEGACY – Preserving the History of Space Exploration

LUNAR LEGACY is an interactive web-based archive created in response to the challenge “Abandoned but not Forgotten.” It aims to highlight the historical and scientific importance of human-made equipment and artefacts left behind during Moon and Mars exploration missions.

The website presents information about selected space exploration artefacts, their missions, purposes, and contributions to scientific discovery. Users can explore the Moon and Mars sections and learn how equipment used in earlier missions became part of space exploration history.

The main benefit of this project is making space heritage information easier to access and understand, especially for students and people interested in astronomy and space technology. It encourages awareness about preserving historical objects beyond Earth and helps communicate the story of past exploration to future generations.

The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Visual Studio Code was used for development, and Netlify was used to host the website.

The creative aspect of LUNAR LEGACY is presenting space heritage through an accessible, interactive digital archive rather than only through traditional articles. The team considered simplicity, accessibility, educational value, historical importance, and ease of navigation while developing the project.
